title: The Land Becomes Like the Garden of Eden
description: The Lord promises through Ezekiel that when He cleanses the people from sin, the ruined cities will be rebuilt and the desolate land cultivated so that it becomes like the Garden of Eden. The surrounding nations will know that the Lord has restored what was destroyed. He also promises to make the people as numerous as the flocks in Jerusalem during the festivals [ref:Ezekiel 36:33-38|Ezekiel 36:33-38].
